claims.statement: Split-reservation orders (EXC-0921) require median 47 minutes for carrier confirmation, but pickup slots are assigned 30-minute windows and close before confirmation arrives
claims.limitation: None - mechanism is verified and reproducible

claims.statement: v18 allocation rule correctly implements split-reservation logic but does not adjust pickup slot assignment timing for split-reservation confirmation lag
claims.limitation: Root cause is in slot-assignment policy, not core allocation algorithm

claims.statement: Orders re-booked after carrier refresh receive valid slots and can proceed; normal non-split-reservation orders assigned to east node complete successfully
claims.limitation: None - demonstrates mechanism and validates mitigation approach

claims.statement: Impact: 186 orders (9% of overnight allocation) held indefinitely until slot windows are extended or orders are re-booked with longer slot timeouts

next_action.rationale: Root cause is confirmed: v18 split-reservation orders expire before carrier can confirm due to undersized 30-minute slot windows. Mitigation is reversible and authorized: extend pickup slot windows for EXC-0921 scope to 60 minutes (accommodate 47-minute median + buffer). This allows carrier confirmations to arrive before slot expiration, unblocking the 186 held orders. This is a one-time correction to the specific affected cohort with no side effects to other orders or systems.
